key_concepts: Creates CHOP channels from numeric values in a DAT table.
The source DAT should already be in table format; Convert DAT set to To Table is the official normalization path for non-table text.
Row extraction and column extraction each support all, name range, index range, mixed name/index, explicit values, and expression-condition modes.
Selection by values depends on From Column for rows and From Row for columns, so planners must preserve the intended label axis.
Output mode changes the resulting CHOP shape between one channel, channel per row, channel per column, or channel per extracted value.
First Row and First Column can be ignored, used as names, or treated as values, which affects both channel names and sample data.
common_gotchas: The source DAT should be in table form; use Convert DAT to normalize arbitrary text before conversion.
Named row and column selection relies on table labels matching exactly or by pattern.
First row/first column naming settings can silently change channel names and values.
